summary: The comment supports continued operation of the E-Rate program for its essential role in providing connectivity to schools and libraries, emphasizing the cost implications of scaling back the program.

claims.requested_action: Maintain continued operation of the E-Rate program
claims.argument: If the E-Rate plan is scaled back, schools will have to cut other services to keep vital internet connectivity
claims.evidence_quote: If the E-Rate plan is scaled back, our schools will have to cut other services and programs to keep vital internet connectivity.
